Rev 1 · What changed

Whole-house review: north-wall TV and facing sofa, southwest dining, corner stove, laundry sink, bathroom fixture corrections, and basement posts. Basement dry bar removed. Furniture and finishes are an editable proposal.

Revised primary suite, basement storage and access, garage-entry landing, and bedroom numbering. Front door = east; back door = west. Stairs: upper flight at the front/east, lower flight at the back/west. The two primary-bath B windows are specified as tempered in the drawing. Vertical stair dimensions and garage landing dimensions remain schematic.

Bedroom → walk-in closet → bathroom. The bath slides into Bedroom 2; the private hallway is removed.

Starting rooms: 152 sq ft closet · 173 sq ft bath

A-101 / A-102, Revision 1 · October 6, 2026. Wall footprints follow the revised PDF and basement redline. The printed plot date is September 22; the revision date governs this model.

Front door = east (+Y on the plan); back door = west (−Y). The upper flight enters on the front/east side and the lower flight exits toward the back/game room. The right-hand stair wall stays intact. The stair footprint is retained; vertical rise, treads and garage landing dimensions remain schematic. Roof profiles are carried forward from the earlier sections because this revision contains only floor plans.

Suite fixture footprints follow the drawing symbols. Cabinet construction, materials and lighting remain editable proposals. The two B windows in the primary bath carry the tempered-glass note. Final products and field dimensions still need confirmation.

A dimensionally grounded concept, pending confirmation. The expanded suite adds proposed partitions and openings to a copy of the original geometry. Its dimensions are in the comparison study; the source checks below apply to retained source spans. Walls were extracted from the PDF vector geometry at 18 PDF points per foot and include a modeled ½″ finish each side of the extracted studs. This is a plan model, not an as-built survey. The basement follows the August 24, 2026 A-101 review sheet marked preliminary, not for construction. Its 8″ foundation and interior stud lining are traced separately before the modeled finish is added.

These checks validate selected source spans and the PDF scale. They do not certify every opening, mesh, or field measurement. The 74′ overall annotation excludes the primary-bath projection, which extends farther.

What needs confirmation

  • Ceilings: 9′ flat rooms follow A-102. Great-room slope follows the 8:12 parallel-chord section with a modeled 12′ spring line. The primary bedroom follows the 4:12 shed section. Internal kitchen/pantry partitions are capped at 9′. The modeled transition to the flat ceiling closes at the 27′ great-room depth. That transition and the garage scissor-truss profile need actual truss or field dimensions.
  • Openings: nominal window and door sizes follow the schedule. Frames, trim, actual rough openings, and operating clearances need product specifications.
  • Kitchen and baths: the island starts at the written 4′ × 8′ with 4′ aisles. The detailed kitchen is a proposed module layout with a synchronized schedule and elevations. Appliance selections, cabinet joinery, fillers, countertop support and field measurements remain subject to cabinet-maker approval. Bathroom vanities also have dimensioned cases, fronts and stone schedules. Sink products and hardware are provisional.
  • Construction changes: confirm that this June 1 set matches the first floor as built. The revised basement includes its rooms, closets, bath, office, dry bar, and storage. Floors are shown separately at a local floor datum. Walking into the stair entrance, pressing E nearby, or using the stair buttons connects the landings; tread geometry and the floor-to-floor rise remain schematic until field dimensions are confirmed.
  • Realistic mode: continuous real-time rendering with anti-aliasing, contact shading, local reflections and three shadowed fixture lights. Quality and exposure are adjustable. Lighting is illustrative; this is not a calibrated daylight or photometric simulation.
  • Lighting: proposed fixtures and illustrative lighting. No electrical circuit design, sun study, code review, or photometric calculation is implied.

For the next pass: confirm ceiling heights and slopes, changes to walls and openings, and cabinet/appliance/fixture specifications.

    Walk through it, try your ideas, then take the whole editable app with you.

    1. Download and unzip the app.

      Use Codex, Claude Code, Cursor or another assistant. Ask it to read README.md and AGENTS.md, start the app locally, then describe what you want to change.

      Your files and browser edits are independent of this site. Fork the repository if you want your own hosted version.
